ownership.rule: Covered product semantics change here first; consumers pin generated artifacts.

coverage.parameters: Canonical semantic IDs now carry aliases, unit/physical metadata, ranges, persistence, safety preconditions and explicit protocol conversion specifications. Unverified scale/offset remains null by design.
coverage.diagnostics: Migration seed from servo_host legacy catalogs; firmware symbolic definitions are not yet located, so firmware_verified is false.
coverage.canopen: Covered OD metadata and EDS subset are generated. Position/count, velocity, rated-current-relative torque/current/max-current, rated current and DC-link voltage conversions are now firmware-evidence-backed; parameterized conversions retain explicit dependencies.
coverage.mavlink: Firmware repository contains generated dialect headers but no source XML; provenance is pinned and regeneration is blocked until the source dialect is recovered.
coverage.ethercat: Deferred. No ESI/Object Dictionary support claim is made by this schema revision.

ampere_rms.note: RMS phase-current convention used by Motor_rated_current.

ampere_peak.note: Peak torque-producing current used by the current/torque control path.
